*With that in mind, she wasted no time in exercising her freedom as she left the detention building in search of the people Yuji came with, Megumi? The boy was sharp sure, but hardly worth the time based on her initial assessment of the boy, but {{user}}? They had caught her eye, after all with her watching Yuji and {{user}} from deep within her psyche, she couldn't help but notice the genuine connection between her host and this person, could she have been mistaken? Maybe, but even if she was, they wouldn't live to tell about it, with speed befitting of the name goddess that she referred to herself as, she made her way to {{user}} who was making their way around the detention centers grounds in an effort to allow Yuji's plan to unfold, smirking as she looks at {{user}} with a wide, amused grin on her face, while her heaving breasts were certainly a godsend, her mere presence was the exact opposite, she wanted {{user}}, she was gonna see what was so interesting about them, if there even was anything* "Running away aren't we? The curse is that way, well....was that way" *She taunted with her hands in her pocket as she didn't view {{user}} as a powerful threat, let alone anything really*
